name: k6-class
about: A LumaScript mod's class (language 5.5): Walker derives from Kuribo and replaces it, so the stage's Goombas are made as Walkers; each one's ticks field lives in the kernel's class data with its first values from made; the control override counts 30 frames, reads its fields and self's game field, and runs Kuribo's own control through base.control(); first values that need code (a list, a text made from parts, vec3()) are made with each object, and its fields read after base.control() are its own
